name: AlphaX POS Order Type
description: Service mode. One row per way of serving a guest — Dine In, Takeaway, Delivery, Room Service, Credit. The register reads these flags at boot and enforces them: whether a table is required, whether a customer or delivery platform must be named, whether a KOT prints, and which price list applies.

fields.label: Order Type
fields.description: Stored on the invoice as alphax_order_type. Renaming an existing type breaks reporting continuity — disable and add instead.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Single emoji or glyph shown on the register button.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Left-to-right order on the register. Lowest first.

fields.label: Default On Open
fields.description: The mode a new sale starts in. If more than one is ticked, the lowest sort order wins.

fields.label: Outlet
fields.description: Leave blank to offer this mode at every outlet.

fields.label: Table
fields.description: Mandatory blocks payment until a table is picked and opens the floor plan as soon as the mode is chosen. Not Applicable hides the table chip entirely and clears any table already held.

fields.label: Requires Delivery Platform
fields.description: Aggregator modes: the full amount posts to the platform's Mode of Payment.

fields.label: Room / Folio
fields.description: Hospitality. Mandatory asks for an in-house room before payment and posts the charge to that folio instead of tendering cash.

fields.label: Requires Cover Count
fields.description: Ask how many guests are seated. Feeds average-spend-per-cover reporting.

fields.label: Requires Manager PIN
fields.description: Staff meals, comps, house accounts — anything that should not be a one-tap choice.

fields.label: Opens A Running Tab
fields.description: The order stays open for more rounds instead of tendering immediately. Dine In and room service behave this way.

fields.label: Posts On Credit
fields.description: No tender screen. Posts an outstanding Sales Invoice against the named customer.

fields.label: Price List Override
fields.description: Channel pricing. Aggregator menus usually carry a marked-up list so commission does not eat the margin.

fields.label: Service Charge %
fields.description: Applied on top of the order when this mode is active. Dine In often carries one; takeaway rarely does.

fields.label: Target Prep Minutes
fields.description: Drives the ageing colour on the kitchen display and the late-order report.
